Name: More Space For Dusty
Author: LunaLavellan
Description:
I'm sure you know about Dusty and his small fenced-off kingdom

...And when I say small I mean borderline animal abuse small, does anyone even walk that poor thing?! I don't know the reason behind that, if there is any, but jesus all he gets is a 3x3 patch of grass?
...Or is it just me?

But less ranting, more acting am I right? This little mod gives Dusty a bit more space to potentially run around in, as well as a trough (?) to drink/bathe/idk it think it looks nice, HOPEFULLY without messing anything up because people like to walk around that thing and I dont know what will happen, though I think I did everything correctly.

So, if anyone tries this out and finds something I messed up on please tell me, your help would be appreciated.
